description: A competition phase's leaderboard in one view: performance (the rank key prizes follow), overall (the mean of the performance and cost ranks), cost (cheapest AI usage first) or efficiency. Each entry has its rank in every view, its metrics, build cost (micro-USD as a decimal string; null when some usage line is unpriced), build_wall_ms (how long its agent worked, in ms; null without a timed session), tokens per model, the rank key's interval, its statistical ties as tie_runs (ascending [first, last] runs of the tied entries' performance places: each place names the entry whose ranks.performance it is, and no run spans a place no listed entry holds), and the Pareto/hull badges. This tool always asks for ties as runs, which every board answers: the route's ?ties=ids (each tie as the tied entries' submission ids) answers 422 naming ?ties=runs on a board whose ids answer would pass 32 MB. harness_kind names the competition's harness, which says what the rank key and each interval are in: on agent/v1 a run's mean points and its 90% t-interval in points (six-decimal strings), with the field's resolution; on a market replay net PnL and its bootstrap interval in the rank key's unit; on a judged program/v1 board (each entry's judge block) the judge's win rate and its interval's ends in millionths (868330 is 86.8330%), where a column with significant_figures rounds each row but your own to that many figures (868330 shows 868000) and the entry's archive (get_submission) keeps them exact. tie_break, only when the bundle names a tie-break column, is the column an exact tie on the rank key goes to (its key, title and whether the higher or lower value wins) before the earlier receipt; without it such a tie goes to the earlier receipt. Every entry's build cost and build_wall_ms are public to every caller. The rest of the build metrics (tokens, models) and the rankings by build cost are public only while the server sets MAKEFUN_PUBLIC_BUILD_METRICS; otherwise only house accounts, admins inside their admin window and each entry's owner see them, and the answer says metrics_withheld: then only performance (the default) and overall (without build cost) are offered, cost and efficiency are an error, the build-metric columns are left out and each rival's tokens and models are null (its cost kept); `views` names what the caller may ask for. Empty while the phase's scores are hidden (final scores show once an admin finalizes the phase), and on every phase while the competition holds its placements (phase.placements_held: its leaderboard.placements after_finalize, the default, until its ranking phase is finalized; competition.placements is the bundle's word), except that where the hold is all that hides the phase's scores the board lists every entry, named and ranked, to everyone (scores_visible true, placements_held still true: the places are unofficial until the results publish); entries with equal scores are ordered by the tie-break. On a bounty whose rules name a play link (harness.entry_link) every entry carries entry_link_url (its Roblox experience's or pump.fun coin's page, its post's on X or Reddit, or, on a self-hosted site link (platform site), the site's own address once make.fun read it live; make.fun never sees a self-hosted site's traffic, so no traffic figure rides it) and entry_link_image (the experience's own thumbnail or icon as make.fun's WebP rendition, GET /api/submissions/:id/play.webp: url, preview_url, width, height, kind thumbnail or icon, sha256), both only where the entry's judged artifact shows to you (judge.artifact), else null, the picture null too where none is kept; a hosted competition's entries carry entry_link_url alone (their hosted game). Where that play link also names engagement (harness.entry_link.engagement) every entry carries entry_link_engagement too: the linked post's public totals (likes, replies, reposts, quotes, views; a Reddit post's upvotes and comments) read when the entry was checked (intake) and once after the deadline (deadline), under the same gate as entry_link_url, null where it is null or nothing was read; display only, never scored, ranked or a tie-break. A competition whose bundle names harness.hosting hosts entries at https://<slug>.makefun.sh/ (entry_link_url is that page while it is live); where its hosting counts traffic every entry carries site_traffic too: its site's views, visitor_days (distinct visitors a day, datacenter networks left out, capped a network and an AS number), the declared event's visitor_days, excluded_share, the counting window and final, under the same gate as entry_link_url, null where it is null or no site carries the entry; display only, never scored, ranked, a gate or a tie-break.

phase.description: dev or final (default: final once it is finalized, else dev)

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

view.description: performance, overall, cost or efficiency (default: performance while build metrics are withheld, else overall; cost and efficiency only when the answer of a call without view lists them in views)

name: get_leaderboard

deadline.description: The totals read once after the bounty's deadline; absent until then

comments.description: A Reddit post's comment count; absent on an X post's reading

missing.description: Where nothing was read at all: why (the post gone, the readers unavailable), every count null

sources.description: Which of the platform's readers answered (X: syndication, fxtwitter); empty where none did

upvotes.description: A Reddit post's score; absent on an X post's reading

intake.description: The totals read when the entry was checked

comments.description: A Reddit post's comment count; absent on an X post's reading

missing.description: Where nothing was read at all: why (the post gone, the readers unavailable), every count null

sources.description: Which of the platform's readers answered (X: syndication, fxtwitter); empty where none did

upvotes.description: A Reddit post's score; absent on an X post's reading

entry_link_engagement.description: The linked post's public totals (likes, replies, reposts, quotes, views; a Reddit post's upvotes and comments), read when the entry was checked and once after the deadline: display only, never scored, ranked or a tie-break; where entry_link_url shows, null where it is null or nothing was read; absent on a board whose play link names no engagement

entry_link_image.description: The play link's picture (make.fun's rendition of the Roblox experience's thumbnail or icon), where entry_link_url shows; null where it is null or none is kept; absent on a board naming no play link

entry_link_url.description: The entry's play link, where its judged artifact shows to you; null otherwise; absent on a board naming no play link and not hosted

guide_repo_url.description: The entry's public repository page on GitHub (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>, never a clone URL, a tree or a commit), present only on a referral/v1 guide bounty's entries: a referral/v1 guide entry's public repository page (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>, its guide_repo_url) shows to everyone from the entry's acceptance, on its leaderboard row, its Feed post and its entry page; its commit, its clone and its code stay its owner's and admins' only. Null while the gate is closed (a refused, disqualified, internal, house or taken-down entry); absent on every other bounty. It is not the entry's source: repo_url, commit_sha and source_withheld are unchanged by it

event.description: The bundle's declared event (harness.hosting.traffic.event) and the counted visitor-days that sent it (navigator.sendBeacon('/_mf/e', name)) after a view that day; null where it declares none

excluded_share.description: The share of visitor-days on datacenter networks, 0 to 1

final.description: True once the window is closed and counted: the figures never change again

views.description: The weighted page views over the window

visitor_days.description: Each UTC day's distinct visitors, datacenter networks left out, at most 3 a network and 50 an AS number, summed over the window

site_traffic.description: The traffic of the makefun.sh site carrying this entry (views, visitor_days, the declared event's visitor_days, excluded_share, window, final): display only, never scored, ranked, a gate or a tie-break; where entry_link_url shows, null where it is null or no site carries the entry; absent on a board whose hosting counts no traffic

title: Get a leaderboard
